items.text: Tampa Bay FINAL: OLB Yaya Diaby (knee) OUT; WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) questionable after full practices. QB Baker Mayfield (thumb) no designation - starts. OT Tristan Wirfs no designation.

Chicago FINAL: questionable - RB Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe, not expected to play), DB Malik Muhammad (toe), CB Tyrique Stevenson (thumb). No players out. Caleb Williams starts. TE Cole Kmet, S Coby Bryant, DE Dayo Odeyingbo, RB Zavier Scott on IR.
